functions_changed: build (Phase 3 loop extended with resolveCallChain() call)
extractCallbackBody (anonymous visitor: added currentClass tracking + class-aware method match — P1 fix)
files_modified.behavior_before: Phase 3 ran SourceSinkVisitor only on the direct callback body. Sinks in methods called via $this->method() were invisible — IR had source but no sink for delegated patterns.
files_modified.behavior_after: After SSV traversal of callback body, resolveCallChain() is called when callback has a class context. For each $this->method() call found: looks up method via SymbolTable::findMethod(), parses its body, runs SSV with inherited entry_point_id, recurses up to depth=2 with cycle detection via $visited[]. extractCallbackBody() now tracks current Class_ context during traversal and requires class name match when resolving methods — prevents wrong-class-same-name false match in multi-class files.

post_review_fix.issue: P1 — extractCallbackBody() matched ClassMethod by name only, ignoring class context. In a file with multiple classes sharing a helper name, resolveCallChain() could resolve the wrong class body.
post_review_fix.fix_description: Added currentClass tracking in anonymous visitor (enterNode tracks Class_ node name; leaveNode resets to null). Method match now requires classMatches=true when $this->class is set, using short name and suffix match to handle namespaced classes.
post_review_fix.verified_by: plugins/multi-class-test: SQL sink correctly attached to SecondClass entry point (not file-level). FirstClass echo sink correctly file-level. Anomaly rule_04 fires. Happy-path call-chain-test unchanged. backwpup QS=1.0 FP=0.
